summary: Finds the nearest interactable in range and fires prompt and interact events.
overview: Drop it on the player. It finds the nearest IInteractable within range and fires events to show or hide a prompt and to trigger the interaction on a key press. Detection uses an OverlapSphere, so it works with any collider layout — no trigger volume hand-placed on every interactable.
useCases: A "Press E to open" prompt on doors, chests and NPCs.
Picking up items by walking near them.
Any interaction where the nearest thing should win.

params.tuning: The main cost control — zero scans every frame, which is rarely necessary. A tenth of a second is usually indistinguishable.
Narrow it. A wide mask means every collider in range is tested every scan.
The OverlapSphere radius. Large radii in a dense scene are where this gets expensive.

gotchas.title: Nearest by distance, not by what you are looking at
gotchas.body: Standing between two interactables picks the closer one regardless of facing. Pair it with LookAtTargetFinder if aim should decide.

gotchas.title: Interactables need colliders
gotchas.body: The OverlapSphere finds colliders, so an interactable without one is invisible to it.
